sourceNotes.rawContent: Express your style with this elegant "Love" script bracelet featuring delicate crystal accents. Lightweight and trendy, it adds a romantic, modern touch to any outfit—perfect for daily wear and special occasions. To preserve its radiant luster, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, and storing it safely in a dry place after use.

notes: category: "bracelets" is a PROPOSAL, not source data — the source had no category. Basis: the title and description both describe the piece as a bracelet, and the original category label was "Bracelet under ₹99". Requires explicit owner confirmation at review.
Title-only fact: the title calls this a gold bracelet, but rawContent states no colour or plating, so no Colour candidate is proposed (the title is not quotable as a source).
